en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small passenger steamship on calm water. The vessel is decorated with strings of triangular flags running between two tall masts. The ship's funnel rises from the center, and several people stand along the railings on the bow. The name "MOTALA EXPRESS" is visible on the hull, and a caption reading "S/S Motala Express." appears in the lower left corner.
